newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Orient raises HK$54 mln in shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Asia Orient raises HK$54 mln in shr issue.

text.p: Asia Orient Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to issue 20 million new shares at HK$2.70 each to Full Speed Investments Ltd, raising gross proceeds of HK$54 million for debt repayment and working capital.

The company said in a statement that Full Speed Investments, a substantial shareholder, had also agreed to place 20 million existing shares, or 4.4 percent of Asia Orient's existing issued capital, at HK$2.70 each with Steady Profit Investment Ltd.
Steady Profit is not connected with the company and intends to hold the stake as a long term investment.

Full Speed Investments is owned by Asia Orient managing director Poon Jing, who will own about 54.2 percent of Asia Orient after the transactions, compared with about 56.6 percent before the transactions.
The new shares represent about 4.2 percent of Asia Orient's enlarged issued share capital.
Asia Orient shares closed at HK$2.825 on Wednesday.
